name: Ano Natsu no Hi
source:
One summer day, Aika makes a mistake at the pool that would greatly change her life.
She left the house wearing a swimsuit and forgot to pack underwear to change into.
On the way home, she ended up in a world that she could have never imagined.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ253789.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
某个夏日，Aika在游泳池犯了一个疏忽，却彻底改变了她的人生。
她穿着泳衣出了门，却忘记带替换的内衣。
回家途中，她最终踏入了一个从未想象过的世界。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ253789.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
